limits: Source muscle/bone geometry only; skin/hand/nail reconstruction assessed separately. Sampled errors, not global Hausdorff certificates. Meshopt error inputs are targets, not the measured maxima.

arms.method: Decoded GLB bind-space; up to 1800 evenly spaced vertices and 1600 deterministic area-weighted interior points each direction; exact closest point on source/candidate triangles, accelerated by a complete triangle bounding-sphere lower-bound search. Sampled error, not certified global Hausdorff.
